post.title: What is Purple Lemon Photography? Part One
post.excerpt:
About a year ago when we were updating our website and giving our logo a refresher, part of that process was asking a lot of questions about what Purple Lemon Photography really is. Some parts of how I used to operate were no longer things I was pursuing, and other things have been added to the mix over time.
So here’s the scoop- the fresh view of what makes up Purple Lemon Photography. Each part is like a little slice of my creative spirit.
Wedding + Engagement Photography | Family Portraiture Fine Art Decor | Teaching + Mentoring | Volunteering + Serving
I’ll be exploring these in more detail in the next few posts, so you can learn more about why we do what we do.
